services.name: Private Limited Company Registration
services.shortDesc: The gold standard corporate structure for tech startups, scalable businesses, and fundraising.
services.fullDesc: Incorporate your Private Limited company under the Companies Act, 2013 with complete SPICe+ Part A & B filings, DSC Class-3 tokens, MOA/AOA drafting, Certificate of Incorporation (COI), PAN, TAN, and EPFO/ESIC bank account opening.
inclusions: SPICe+ Part A Name Reservation (2 choices)
2 Class-3 Digital Signature Certificates (DSC USB Tokens)
Drafting of Memorandum (MOA) and Articles of Association (AOA)
Govt ROC SPICe+ Part B Incorporation Filing
Certificate of Incorporation (COI) with CIN number
Corporate PAN and TAN allotment
Zero-balance Current Bank Account opening assistance
PF, ESI and Professional Tax registration numbers
exclusions: Authorized Capital above ₹15 Lakhs (Statutory MCA ROC fee applies)
requiredDocuments: PAN Card copy of all Directors & Shareholders
Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card, Passport, or Voter ID)
Address Proof (Bank statement or Electricity bill < 60 days)
Registered Office proof (Electricity / Water / Gas bill < 60 days)
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from Property Owner
Passport size photographs of all directors

faqs.q: What is the minimum capital required to register a Private Limited company?
faqs.a: There is zero minimum paid-up capital requirement under the Companies Act. You can start with as little as ₹1,000 or the standard ₹1,00,000 authorized capital.

faqs.q: Can a residential address be used as the registered office?
faqs.a: Yes, Indian corporate law allows your residential or rented home to be registered as the official corporate office as long as you provide a utility bill and landlord NOC.

faqs.q: Why does BharatFilings separate Government Stamp Duty from the professional fee?
faqs.a: State stamp duty varies between ₹860 (Delhi) to ₹10,000 (Punjab). We practice radical transparency so you only pay the exact statutory government fee with zero markups or GST on sovereign taxes.

services.name: One Person Company (OPC)
services.shortDesc: Corporate status for solo founders with 100% control and limited liability protection.
services.fullDesc: Start your single-founder enterprise with all corporate privileges. Enjoy limited liability, separate legal entity status, and seamless conversion into a Private Limited company as your business expands.
inclusions: Name Reservation on MCA CRC Portal
1 Class-3 Digital Signature Certificate (DSC)
Nominee Consent Drafting (INC-3 form)
MOA and AOA drafting for single director
COI, PAN, TAN and Bank Account assistance
exclusions: Foreign national as sole member (Only Indian resident allowed for OPC)
requiredDocuments: PAN Card and Aadhaar Card of Sole Director and Nominee
Bank statement or utility bill of Director (< 60 days old)
Registered office utility bill and NOC

faqs.a: Yes, an OPC can employ unlimited staff and contractors; only ownership is held by 1 director.

services.name: Limited Liability Partnership (LLP)
services.shortDesc: Ideal for consulting practices, law firms, and bootstrapped businesses with zero audit mandate up to 40L turnover.
services.fullDesc: Combine the operational flexibility of a traditional partnership with limited liability protection. No mandatory statutory audit required unless turnover exceeds ₹40 Lakhs or capital contribution exceeds ₹25 Lakhs.
inclusions: RUN-LLP Name Approval filing
2 Designated Partner DSC Class-3 tokens
FiLLiP Incorporation Form filing on MCA V3
LLP Agreement drafting & Form 3 filing
Certificate of Incorporation, PAN & TAN
exclusions: State Stamp Duty on LLP Agreement (varies by capital)
requiredDocuments: PAN Card and Aadhaar of at least 2 Partners
Address proof of partners and registered office premises

faqs.q: Is audit mandatory for LLP every year?
faqs.a: No. LLPs are exempt from statutory audit if annual turnover is below ₹40 Lakhs and capital contribution is below ₹25 Lakhs.

services.name: New GST Registration
services.shortDesc: Mandatory Goods & Services Tax identification number (GSTIN) with Aadhaar authentication.
services.fullDesc: Get your 15-digit GSTIN within 3 to 7 working days. Comprehensive filing covering business activity HSN/SAC codes, state jurisdiction, bank account addition, and biometric/Aadhaar OTP authentication.
inclusions: Jurisdiction & HSN/SAC classification analysis
GST REG-01 application filing on GSTN Portal
Aadhaar e-KYC OTP authentication coordination
Clarification drafting if tax officer issues REG-03 query
Final GST Certificate (REG-06) download
exclusions: Physical premises verification if flagged by department
requiredDocuments: PAN Card of Business / Proprietor / Partners
Aadhaar Card with linked mobile number
Premises proof (Electricity bill + Rent Agreement/NOC)
Cancelled cheque or bank account statement

faqs.a: Mandatory if turnover exceeds ₹40 Lakhs (goods) or ₹20 Lakhs (services), or for any interstate sales and e-commerce selling.

services.name: Trademark (TM) Application Filing
services.shortDesc: Protect your brand name, logo, and slogan under the Trade Marks Act, 1999.
services.fullDesc: Secure national intellectual property rights over your brand name, logo, or tagline. Includes deep phonetic search across Class 1 to 45, TM-A application filing with IP India, and issuance of immediate ™ symbol usage rights.
inclusions: Comprehensive Public Trademark Search in NICE Classification
Form TM-A drafting and filing on IP India portal
Immediate legal right to use ™ symbol
Power of Attorney drafting (Form 48)
Filing receipt and application number
exclusions: Hearing representation or examination reply (if objected)
requiredDocuments: Brand Name / Logo artwork in high resolution
Identity & Address proof of applicant
Udyam Registration Certificate (for 50% govt fee concession)
Signed Power of Attorney

faqs.q: How fast can I start using the ™ mark?
faqs.a: Within 24 hours of filing Form TM-A, you receive official acknowledgement and can legally use the ™ symbol.

services.name: Udyam MSME Registration
services.shortDesc: Official MSME recognition for government subsidies, collateral-free bank loans & 50% trademark fee discount.
services.fullDesc: Obtain lifetime valid Udyam Registration Certificate from the Ministry of MSME. Unlocks priority sector bank lending, 45-day payment protection under MSMED Act, and international trade fair subsidies.
inclusions: NIC Code mapping for business activities
Direct filing on official Udyam Portal
Instant Udyam Registration Certificate with QR Code
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Number of Entrepreneur linked with mobile
PAN Card of Business / Proprietor
Bank Account details (Account No. & IFSC)

faqs.q: Does Udyam registration have an expiry date?
faqs.a: No, Udyam certificate has lifetime validity with zero renewal fee.

services.name: Annual ROC Compliance & Financials
services.shortDesc: Mandatory annual MCA filing: AOC-4 (Financials), MGT-7 (Annual Return) & DIR-3 KYC.
services.fullDesc: Fulfill all statutory compliance mandates under the Companies Act, 2013 to avoid ₹100/day penal MCA late fees. Handled end-to-end by practicing Company Secretaries and Chartered Accountants.
inclusions: Preparation of Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss accounts
Filing of Form AOC-4 (Financial Statements)
Filing of Form MGT-7 / MGT-7A (Annual Return)
Director DIR-3 KYC Web/e-Form filing
Statutory Secretarial registers maintenance
exclusions: Statutory Audit fees if done by third-party CA firm
requiredDocuments: Bank statements for entire financial year
Purchase and Sale invoices / Ledger summaries
Valid DSC tokens of at least 1 Director

faqs.q: What is the penalty for not filing annual returns?
faqs.a: The MCA levies a statutory penalty of ₹100 per day per form with no upper cap until filed, risking director disqualification.

services.name: Class-3 Digital Signature Certificate (DSC)
services.shortDesc: CCA certified Class-3 cryptographic USB hardware token with 2-year validity.
services.fullDesc: Get a FIPS-certified USB cryptographic token (ProxKey or ePass2003) loaded with CCA-approved Class-3 Signing Certificate. Mandatory for MCA V3, Income Tax, GST, EPFO, and e-Tendering portals.
inclusions: Class-3 Signing Certificate with 2-Year Validity
FIPS-Compliant USB Cryptographic Hardware Token
2-Minute paperless Video KYC link
Token courier delivery across India
requiredDocuments: PAN Card & Aadhaar Card of applicant
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar

faqs.q: Can I sign documents from my mobile phone with this DSC?
faqs.a: The cryptographic token is a USB hardware key designed for laptops/desktops with Windows/Mac drivers for maximum security.

services.name: FSSAI Food Business License & Registration
services.shortDesc: Mandatory 14-digit food safety license for restaurants, cloud kitchens, manufacturers & D2C food brands.
services.fullDesc: Obtain your 14-digit FSSAI Registration or State License under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. Mandatory for all food businesses, cloud kitchens, caterers, e-commerce food vendors (Zomato/Swiggy), and grocery retailers.
inclusions: Eligibility analysis (Basic Registration vs State License)
Form A / Form B application preparation on FoSCoS portal
Food category mapping and hygiene affidavit drafting
FoSCoS government filing and scrutiny clearance
14-digit FSSAI Certificate download
exclusions: Medical fitness certificate of food handlers (to be self-procured)
State license government fee for turnover > ₹12 Lakhs
requiredDocuments: Passport photo of food business operator (FBO)
Government ID proof (PAN / Aadhaar / Voter ID)
Premises address proof (Electricity bill + Rent Agreement/NOC)
List of food products / menu items

faqs.q: Is FSSAI mandatory for selling food on Swiggy or Zomato?
faqs.a: Yes, both Swiggy and Zomato strictly require an active 14-digit FSSAI license before approving restaurant onboarding.

services.name: Import Export Code (IEC) Registration
services.shortDesc: 10-digit DGFT trade identifier for importing goods or exporting services/products globally.
services.fullDesc: Obtain lifetime valid Import Export Code (IEC) issued by the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT), Ministry of Commerce. Mandatory for international bank remittances, customs clearance, and global cross-border trade.
inclusions: DGFT Portal profile creation & e-KYC authentication
ANF-2A application filing with Ministry of Commerce
Linking of Bank Account with AD Code / PFMS
Electronic Import Export Code (e-IEC) issuance with QR Code
requiredDocuments: PAN Card of Business entity or Proprietor
Aadhaar Card of authorized signatory
Cancelled cheque or bank certificate showing Account No. & IFSC
Registered premises address proof

faqs.q: Does an IEC require annual renewal fees?
faqs.a: No, the IEC license is valid for a lifetime with zero renewal fees. DGFT only requires a free annual online detail confirmation between April-June.
